messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PDR-2026-AZ2 - AZ2 inference serving latency > 5s for 90% p50/p90 on gpu-pool-3. Severity: P1. Paging: oncall-sre.
PagerDuty: Incident PDR-2026-AZ2 created. Escalation policy: infra-sre -> eng-lead.
Dinesh: acked. I'm on it. Pulling up autoscaler and routing metrics.
Alice: oncall handoff in 25m if needed. tagging for regional ops.
Ben: seeing surge in batch-queue length for az2-batch-queue. 10x normal. Likely a slow KV cache miss storm.
Carla: confirming elevated Redis miss rate and CPU for kv-cache-az2-1. Logs show repeated cache misses and backend weight increase.
Maya: customer impact: API 503s spiking for customers in eu-west mapped to AZ2. CS-Bot: creating incident banner draft.
Oncall SRE: Can we divert new requests to AZ1/AZ3? What's the routing policy?
Dinesh: routing policy for hosted-api: prefer same-region AZ, fallback to same-region other azs if latency < 50ms, otherwise cross-region. We need to enable aggressive fallback to AZ1/AZ3 for read/write paths.
Ben: starting canary reroute for 10% of traffic from az2 -> az1 via dynamic routing controller. Command:```curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/reroute -d '{"from":"az2","to":"az1","percent":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'```
Carla: spinning an emergency kv-cache replica in AZ1 (kv-cache-az1-2). Starting warm restore from snapshot. ETA ~ 7m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-2026-AZ2 acknowledged by Dinesh. Next escalation in 8 minutes if unack.
Maya: CS-Bot posted temporary status: "Degraded performance for EU customers in az2; routing fallback in progress. No data loss." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PDR-2026-AZ2
Dinesh: increasing pool size for gpu-pool-3 in AZ2 by +2 nodes as short-term capacity. AWS API call queued.
Ben: queue length reduced by 30% after canary reroute. Latency p90 down from 6.2s -> 2.8s for rerouted traffic.
Oncall SRE: seeing 503s drop for customers on rerouted path. Need to observe KV warm-up and cache hit-rate.
Carla: Redis warm-restore shows keys copying, current replication lag 12s, expected <2s when warm.
Alice: I'm preparing a canary rollback plan in case reroute increases errors. Also tagging product leads.
Dinesh: if no improvement within 12m, escalate to eng-lead for mitigation budget approval (reserve capacity).
PagerDuty: Escalation: notified eng-lead (Ben S.) and infra manager (Carla R.).
Ben: got it. I'll join the war room.
Maya: CS has emailed top 5 affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA ~15m.
Oncall SRE: handoff note: I'll stay on until 20:15Z or until primary restored. Alice will take follow-up after that.
Dinesh: Traffic fully shifted to AZ1/AZ3 for non-sticky sessions. Observability: p95 now ~1.4s for rerouted; az2 still degraded but trending.
Carla: replication completed on kv-cache-az1-2. Cache hit-rate improving from 12% -> 42% in last 3m.
Maya: CS reporting a reduction in incoming tickets. Banner updated to include 'mitigation in progress'.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-2026-AZ2 update posted. Next reminder in 10 minutes.
Ben: I've triggered an emergency canary to redirect write-heavy customers to dedicated dedicated-pool-us-east for affected sessions. Keeping sticky sessions sticky where possible.
Dinesh: initiated post-incident flagging: create INCIDENT-2026-AZ2 for postmortem + RCA owner. Assigning to Carla.
Carla: accepted owner. Will collect KV telemetry, autoscaler logs, and routing controller traces.
Alice: handoff now. @Dinesh you take the clock to finalize runbook, I'll update runbook with steps we took for fallback and scaling.
Dinesh: Roger. Starting timeline notes in the incident doc.
CS-Bot: Notifying Customer Success on Slack channel #customer-impact.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-2026-AZ2 resolved (auto) after health checks recovered for az2. Closing in 5 minutes unless re-opened.
Oncall SRE: Confirming service recover to normal in AZ2. latency p95 back to baseline.
Maya: CS: pushing a follow-up to affected customers with root-cause pending.
Carla: saved snapshots and scaling metrics to incident artifact store: s3://incidents/PDR-2026-AZ2/artifacts.
Dinesh: final note: temporary mitigation = 1) aggressive cross-AZ fallback, 2) emergency kv-cache replicate and warm restore, 3) temporary GPU pool scale-up. We'll run a postmortem with action items: improve cache failover automation, add early-warning for cache miss storms, and tighten autoscaler thresholds.
Alice: +1 on actions. Closing war room. Passing to postmortem owner Carla. Thanks all :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident PDR-2026-AZ2 closed by Dinesh.
